definitions.explanation: Extremely careful, exact, and thorough with no room for looseness or approximation. Used for reasoning, definitions, distinctions, analyses, and other intellectual or procedural matters.

examples.japanese: {厳密|げんみつ}に{言|い}えば{違|ちが}う。
{厳密|げんみつ}な{定義|ていぎ}はまだ{決|き}まっていない。
examples.english: A precise definition has not yet been established.

examples.japanese: この{実験|じっけん}では{温度|おんど}を{厳密|げんみつ}に{管理|かんり}する{必要|ひつよう}がある。
examples.english: In this experiment, the temperature needs to be controlled precisely.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{厳密|げんみつ}に{言|い}えば (strictly speaking)
・{厳密|げんみつ}な{定義|ていぎ} (precise definition)
・{厳密|げんみつ}な{管理|かんり} (strict control)
・{厳密|げんみつ}な{区別|くべつ} (strict distinction)

The adverbial form {厳密|げんみつ}に{言|い}えば is one of the most common patterns. Distinguished from {厳格|げんかく} (strict regarding people/rules/discipline) in that {厳密|げんみつ} focuses on precision and exactness of information or procedures.
